context_keys.topic: what the desk is focused on right now
context_keys.watchlist: a list of symbols under active attention; the desk renders a live closes strip from it
context_keys.quotes/: one key per symbol, canonical: {"refresh": {"tool": "live_quote", "args": {"symbol": "NVDA"}, "minutes": 1, "value_path": "result.data.quote", "into": "quote"}} — a standing reqMktData stream keeps it current; the desk renders entry.quote {bid, ask, last, observed_at} as a live chip. Use quote_snapshot only for one-off or slow-cadence reads.
context_keys.findings/: one key per finding: {title, source, as_of} — evidence worth keeping; the desk renders the findings feed from these
context_keys.answers/: the member's replies to ask cards, one key per card id — direction and risk decisions only; fills need no answers
context_keys.desk/hidden: cells the member hid from their own view (data keeps refreshing): {keys, as_of} — member-owned; treat as feedback per the research-funnel framing, never write it
context_keys.desk/streams: the autopilot's watchlist stream health, refreshed each pass: {quotes: {SYMBOL: {last, observed_at, age_seconds} | null}, stale: [symbols], checked_at}. If a symbol goes stale or null the member SEES it and you can act: re-warm with live_quotes {warm: true}, or check capabilities/system_health for the broken lane. Never write this key.
context_keys.desk/name: the member's own label for this desk, set in the desks menu — agents never write it
context_keys.desk/next_check: the agent's own next check-in clock (ISO-8601 UTC, >=10 minutes out); the autopilot honors it
context_keys.desk/focus: one line: what the next check-in should look at
context_keys.desk/autopilot: the autopilot's last action: {last_turn, reason, builds_today, budget} — written by tools/autopilot.py, never by the agent
context_keys.desk/audit: the autopilot's latest gate audit of every trade: {clean, cases_checked, violations, as_of} — if it names violations, fixing them is the next turn's first job
context_keys.widgets/: the desk: one declarative card per key (widgets convention)
context_keys.widgets/brief: the pinned Today card: what the desk is doing and what needs eyes
context_keys.trades/: one key per trade: {contracts: [1-5 exact contracts], thesis, evidence: [context keys], invalidation, state: idea|watching|open-simulated|closed, fill, exit, as_of}. invalidation is always written. fill stays null until the market gate passes — the autopilot records a supported order's exact receipt block {contract, price, bid, ask, quantity, observed_at}; agents never write fill blocks and carry existing ones through unchanged. exit: same shape, closed trades only. The audit (desk/audit) verdicts every trade after each change.
context_keys.forms/: minimal fields the desk expands into finished cells: forms/trade/<id> {contracts, thesis, invalidation} → trades/<id>; forms/<id> {template, ...fields} → the template's cell. Problems come back as `errors` on the form itself; revise and set retry: true.
context_keys.plugins/: the desk's chart-plugin library, plugins/<slug>: {label, describe, appliesTo: contract|underlying|tape|both, overlay: {levels/bands/clocks} | program: {inputs, code} + minutes; program args may carry {"$": "symbol"}-style placeholders filled per trade}. Designed once when the member presses ＋ on a cockpit pane; applying instantiates overlays/<trade>-lib-<slug>
context_keys.overlays/: chart overlays for one trade's cockpit, overlays/<trade-id>-<slug>: {target: contract|underlying, levels: [{price, label}], bands: [{lower, upper, label, side}], clocks: [{at, label}]} — pure data rendered by the cockpit's custom plugin. COMPUTED overlays add program {inputs: [read-only tool reads], code: 'def compute(inputs): return {...}'} + minutes: the runner executes on cadence (restricted namespace, validated output, errors land as last_error). Retire when the moment passes
context_keys.cockpit/: one trade's own cells at cockpit/<trade-id>/<slug> — the desk card grammar, rendered inside that trade's cockpit modal: candidate contracts' live quotes, comparison tables, custom_d3, news
context_keys.plans/: one key per managed position, plans/<trade-id>: {plan: the member's words, status, program, state}. status ladder: requested (member wants a plan — compiling one is the next turn's first job) → draft (agent wrote the program) → active/paused (MEMBER-ONLY moves, made in the UI after inspecting; agents NEVER write active). program = {explanation: prose the member reads, inputs: [{name, tool, args}] read-only tools only, code: 'def manage(inputs, state):' pure Python answering {actions, state}, tests: [{name, inputs, state, expect_actions|expect_no_actions|expect_state_contains}]}. Validate with plan_check before writing. Activated plans are archived to the machine's plan library (browse with plan_library — proven examples beat blank pages); a close adds the judged outcome and retires the plan to status completed. The autopilot gathers the inputs each pass, runs the program, and routes its actions (close, place_exit {price}, cancel_exit, note {text}) through the market gate; `state` persists watermarks between passes. inputs also carry `position` {entry, quantity, contract} and `now` (ET ISO) for free.
context_keys.templates/: desk-designed cell blueprints (deep-model work, done once): {target, fields, cell with {"$": field} placeholders} — extend the shipped templates; any model then operates them via forms/

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Which lanes are live on this machine: inline public data always; the full engine (broker, options, gamma) when installed. data: {lanes, full_engine}.

tools.name: price_summary
tools.description: End-of-day price summary from public data — no keys, no accounts. Close, 1d/1m change, 30d range. data: {close, close_label, date, change_1d_pct, change_1m_pct, range_30d}.

args.symbol: ticker or index, e.g. NVDA, SPX

tools.name: daily_bars
tools.description: Daily closes from public data for charting — points ready for a line card. data: {points [[date, close]…], candles [[date, o, h, l, c]…], last}.

tools.name: live_quotes
tools.description: Freshest streamed ticks for up to 10 symbols in one engine call — the watchlist's real-time lane. Quiet symbols get their streams started and one retry. data: {quotes: {SYMBOL: {bid, ask, last, close, observed_at} | null}}.

args.symbols: list of tickers (or comma string), up to 10
args.warm: true once to start quiet symbols' streams (slow); omit for fast reads

tools.name: form_check
tools.description: Validate or expand one form without writing anything: a trade form answers the normalized trade; a template form answers {target, cell}. Violations are named and teachable. data: {trade|target+cell, violations}.

tools.name: plan_library
tools.description: Browse this machine's saved management plans — every member-activated plan, plus judged outcomes once the position closed. The place to look for proven examples before writing a new program. data: {plans: [{trade_id, plan, status, program, state, outcome?, saved_at}]}.

tools.name: plan_check
tools.description: Validate a position-management plan's program and run its own tests — every verdict named. Nothing is written; a plan whose tests fail cannot be activated by the member. data: {violations, tests: [{name, passed, detail}], passed}.

args.plan: the plans/<id> value (or just {program}) to check

tools.name: contract_bars
tools.description: Historical bars for one exact contract (stock or option) straight from the broker — the lane behind the positions sparkline. data: {rows: [{bar_time, open, high, low, close}]}.

tools.name: symbol_zones
tools.description: Supply/demand zones for one symbol, freshly derived from broker bars — no stale substitution: when the historical-bars lane is down the receipt says so and answers no rows. data: {ready, symbol, timeframe, rows: [zone rows]}.

tools.name: tick_tape
tools.description: The freshest persisted ticks for one contract — read-only (action is always latest). The bot's microstructure input. data: {rows: [{bid, ask, last, quote_time}...]} newest first.

tools.name: rss_fetch
tools.description: One RSS/Atom feed as bounded story rows — the news lane. Wire a card per feed (e.g. a ticker's headline feed) with a refresh program; read the landed items next turn; stories worth keeping become findings with link and clock. data: {feed_title, url, items: [{title, link, published, summary}]}.

tools.name: web_fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public web page or file the member pointed at and learn from it — static GET, no keys, HTML stripped to text with script bodies kept (for chart examples, the code is the lesson). Local/private addresses refused by structure. Use via a card's refresh program; read the landed text next turn. data: {url, content_type, title, chars, text}.

tools.name: trade_check
tools.description: Validate one trades/<id> value against the trade contract: 1-5 exact contracts, thesis, evidence keys, invalidation always written, honest state, and the fill gates. Answers every violation by name. data: {violations}.

args.id: the trade id, for the summary

tools.name: fill_check
tools.description: The market gate, snapshot lane (one-off checks; prefer fill_watch for working orders). Fetches its own live receipted quote, verifies regular session, freshness, and that the price sits inside bid/ask. No live receipt, no fill. data: {verdict: 'fill-supported', contract, action, fill} on support; {verdict: 'refused', reasons} otherwise.

args.price: the simulated fill price to verify
args.contract: display label for the card, e.g. 'NVDA 8/14 190C'

tools.name: fill_watch
tools.description: The market gate, stream lane: ensures a standing reqMktData subscription for the contract (one leased broker connection, worker-renewed) and gates the freshest persisted tick. The lane for working orders — tick-level truth, no snapshot lease cycle per check. data: {verdict: 'fill-supported', contract, action, fill, stream} on support; {verdict: 'refused', reasons} otherwise.

tools.name: live_quote
tools.description: A continuously current quote from the standing tick stream: ensures the subscription, answers the freshest persisted tick with its own clock. The tool for any card whose price should update consistently. data: {quote: {bid, ask, last, close, bid_size, ask_size, model_iv, delta, observed_at}, stream: {stream_id}}.

tools.name: market_stream
tools.description: Manage the standing reqMktData subscriptions directly: start, stop, status, list_active, latest. fill_watch and live_quote start streams for you; use this to stop one or inspect the registry. data: the stream answer ({stream_id, stream, rows, latest_quote} by action).

args.action: start, stop, status, list_active, or latest

tools.name: system_health
tools.description: Check the data engine: TWS, Timescale, integrations. data: component statuses.

tools.name: quote_snapshot
tools.description: One receipted IBKR quote (one-off/slow-cadence; prefer live_quote where price should stay current): bid/ask/last/mark with source clocks. data: {quote: {bid, ask, last, mid, observed_at}, freshness}.

args.max_age_seconds: serve cached if fresher than this

tools.name: options_chain
tools.description: A bounded options chain snapshot for one underlying. data: the chain answer (expirations, strikes, rows).

tools.name: spx_gamma
tools.description: Latest SPX dealer gamma, strike-level, cached-honest on vendor failure. data: {gamma_v2: {gamma_centroid, regime_v2, total_net_gamma, local_net_gamma_25/_50, spot_vs_centroid}, expiration_pocket_count, collected_at}. NOTE: spot_vs_centroid is in index POINTS (spot minus centroid), not percent.

args.read_only: true to never hit the vendor

tools.name: market_context
tools.description: The desk's market context brief (cached-honest). data: the context brief object (fields vary by focus).

tools.name: short_volume
tools.description: FINRA short volume for tickers. data: rows per ticker per day.

tools.name: implied_move
tools.description: Options-implied move into a dated event. data: the implied-move answer for the event.

tools.name: symbol_research
tools.description: The full research pass on one symbol: bars, zones, options. data: the research answer (bars, zones, options blocks).

questions.question: Which underlyings or topics should the desk watch?
questions.placeholder: NVDA, AMD, SPX — or themes: semis into earnings, rate-sensitive names

questions.question: What should the desk focus on right now?
